definition: OptimalThinkingBench's headline metric: the harmonic mean of AUC_OAA (the overthinking-penalized accuracy score) and UnderthinkingBench accuracy, so a model must score well on both sub-benchmarks to score high overall. No evaluated model optimally balances both: o3 scores best overall (71.1%), GPT-OSS-120B best among open-weight models (68.3%).

evidence.note: Introduces OptimalThinkingBench, a unified benchmark pairing OverthinkingBench (simple queries) and UnderthinkingBench (hard reasoning/math) with a shared F1 metric, showing that none of 33 evaluated LLMs balances accuracy and thinking-token efficiency.
evidence.title: OptimalThinkingBench: Evaluating Over and Underthinking in LLMs

name: F1^otb combined metric
